question: How do Ananta and the other lords shine in their office within the cave?
premises: Their own strength is kindled by his power.
They function as lamps dispelling darkness in the office of the cave.
All of them, from Ananta to those headed by Shatabhava, shine.
inference: Empowered by the higher lord, the whole series of cave-lords from Ananta to Shatabhava illuminate their domain.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the group headed by Shatabhava is not explained here.
plain_english: Strengthened by his power, all those headed by Ananta, down to those headed by Shatabhava, shine as lamps dispelling darkness in the office of the cave.
